typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteGroup as string,
		SiteName as string,
		DataHall as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		AssetName as string,
		Tag as string,
		CabinetUsage as string,
		TotalRU as double,
		InstalledRU as decimal(38,0),
		StrandedRU as decimal(38,0),
		TotalConsumed as double,
		AvailableRU as integer,
		PowerThreshold as double,
		PowerUsed as decimal(38,0),
		PowerFree as double,
		AbandonedRU as integer,
		ReadyUnAssignedRU as integer,
		SpaceNoKW as integer,
		Ready2RUHoles as double,
		PoweredServerCounts as integer,
		PoweredDeviceCounts as integer,
		Powered2RUBlock as double,
		Powered3RUBlock as double,
		DCMFlavor2 as string,
		UnavailableRU as integer,
		MarkedRU as decimal(38,0),
		ClosedRU as integer,
		FreeRU as integer,
		RUMAX as integer,
		RecordStatus as string,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		ServiceCat2 as string,
		CWExclude as boolean,
		Status as string,
		VerifiedRA as string,
		PlanningNotes as string,
		EntID as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		Lifecycle2 as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		RFIDTag as string,
		HeatingLimit as double,
		HeatThreshold as double,
		CanBeAllocatedTo as boolean,
		Layer as string,
		Row as string,
		Column as string,
		Rotation as integer,
		X_mm as decimal(12,2),
		Y_mm as decimal(12,2),
		X_in as decimal(17,6),
		Y_in as decimal(17,6),
		CabinetProfile as string,
		Neighborhood as string,
		IFDNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(IsBlankRow = iif((isNull(SiteGroup) || trim(SiteGroup) == ''), 1, 0),
		CWExclude2 = iif(isNull(CWExclude), null(), CWExclude)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(IsBlankRow == 0,IsBlankRow == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Process,Ignore,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Process sink(input(
		AbandonedRU as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		CabinetUsage as string,
		HeatThreshold as double,
		RUMAX as integer,
		IFDNumber as string,
		CabinetProfile as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		PowerUsed as integer,
		UnavailableRU as integer,
		Lifecycle2 as string,
		RFIDTag as string,
		MarkedRU as integer,
		Status as string,
		ServiceCat2 as string,
		CanBeAllocatedTo as boolean,
		FreeRU as integer,
		EntID as string,
		InstalledRU as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		AssetName as string,
		CWExclude as boolean,
		Neighborhood as string,
		ClosedRU as integer,
		SerialNumber as string,
		PoweredServerCounts as integer,
		DCMFlavor2 as string,
		Ymm as double,
		Row as string,
		Powered2RUBlock as double,
		PowerFree as double,
		Yin as double,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		ReadyUnAssignedRU as integer,
		PlanningNotes as string,
		PoweredDeviceCounts as integer,
		DataHall as string,
		Column as string,
		AvailableRU as integer,
		RecordStatus as string,
		TotalRU as double,
		SpaceNoKW as integer,
		Layer as string,
		Rotation as string,
		Ready2RUHoles as double,
		StrandedRU as integer,
		VerifiedRA as string,
		PowerThreshold as double,
		NlyteID as integer,
		TotalConsumed as double,
		Powered3RUBlock as double,
		Xmm as double,
		HeatingLimit as double,
		Tag as string,
		Xin as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AbandonedRU,
		SiteName,
		CabinetUsage,
		HeatThreshold,
		RUMAX,
		IFDNumber,
		CabinetProfile,
		SiteGroup,
		PowerUsed,
		UnavailableRU,
		Lifecycle2,
		RFIDTag,
		MarkedRU,
		Status,
		ServiceCat2,
		CanBeAllocatedTo,
		FreeRU,
		EntID,
		InstalledRU,
		OperationalStatus,
		AssetName,
		CWExclude,
		Neighborhood,
		ClosedRU,
		SerialNumber,
		PoweredServerCounts,
		DCMFlavor2,
		Ymm = Y_mm,
		Row,
		Powered2RUBlock,
		PowerFree,
		Yin = Y_in,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName,
		WFGrid,
		ReadyUnAssignedRU,
		PlanningNotes,
		PoweredDeviceCounts,
		DataHall,
		Column,
		AvailableRU,
		RecordStatus,
		TotalRU,
		SpaceNoKW,
		Layer,
		Rotation,
		Ready2RUHoles,
		StrandedRU,
		VerifiedRA,
		PowerThreshold,
		NlyteID,
		TotalConsumed,
		Powered3RUBlock,
		Xmm = X_mm,
		HeatingLimit,
		Tag,
		Xin = X_in),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
